name: baseline
source: ADR0300 explicit export, optional missing preparation, identity-only seed; literal canonical payloads

name: raw-plan-spelling-is-not-hash-input
source: ADR0300 hash exact canonical embedded plan, not raw YAML spelling
planPrefix: # A source comment is not plan identity.

name: required-onboarder-missing
source: ADR0300 actual onboarder blockers; question finder required semantics

name: unaccepted-default-still-blocks
source: ADR0120; actual finder ignores unaccepted Default for blockers
planAppend:
variables:
  - name: requiredfact
    required: true
    default: suggested

name: deferred-required-onboarder-allowed
source: ADR0300 preserves finder and ADR0010 deliberate Deferred semantics
planAppend:
variables:
  - name: requiredfact
    required: true
answers:
  plan:
    requiredfact: deferred

name: required-onboardee-does-not-block
planAppend:
variables:
  - name: personalanswer
    required: true
    audience: onboardee

name: inactive-onboarder-does-not-block
source: Actual finder excludes inactive sections; complete graph still validated
planAppend:
sections:
  - id: off
    enabled: false
    variables:
      - name: requiredfact
        required: true

name: wrong-preparation-plan
source: Actual preparation validator exact plan identity

name: missing-owner
source: ADR0300 export owner gate, distinct from permissive preview

name: blank-owner-name
source: ADR0300 named owner; firststeps Unicode whitespace blank rule

name: slack-id-is-not-displayed-route
source: ADR0300 explicit displayable help route, SlackID alone does not qualify

name: unknown-explicit-helper
source: ADR0300 explicit designation; do not echo arbitrary supplied selector

name: invalid-configured-layout
source: Actual locator refusal; no fallback after nonempty configured traversal

name: inactive-unmarked-graph-error
source: ADR0300 full original graph before activity; literal structure diagnostic
planAppend:
sections:
  - id: off
    enabled: false
    requires:
      - PRIVATE_UNKNOWN_SECTION

name: invalid-optional-date-is-not-missing-date
source: Preparation validator calendar guard;0300 preserves supplied-value validation

name: private-recipient-details-not-help-or-log
source: ADR0160/0280 data minimization; preparation stays its own payload
preparationAppend:
name: PRIVATE_RECIPIENT
  companyEmail: private@example.invalid
  plannedStartDate: "2027-01-01"
  timeZone: PRIVATE_ZONE
